representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape is many/low-relation/medium-hierarchy/high-temporality/high-density/high-volatility metrics (brief.md shape table); implementation is a 29-tile metric grid in 4 named groups with per-tile sparkline + delta (source/shots and screenshots/1280x860.png, screenshots/1440x900.png), a 29-segment fleet status strip (app.js:302-308), an event 'Evidence stream' panel, and a 'Change trace' chart+event log — each facet of the shape bundle has a dedicated surface. Primary object is the metric (brief.md 主对象: metric), realized as tile+strip segment+traceable event stream.

primary_task_salience.evidence: The monitor job (anomaly within a glance) dominates first paint: the single crit metric (p99 latency 2443ms, ▲645.6%) is rendered red with glow at top of Payments API group in both operator screenshots; header shows '1 crit' red counter and '9 ev/min'; strip shows one glowing crit segment; the Change Trace panel auto-opens on that crit incident at load (app.js:633-636 'default is the active crit incident', selectMetric(byId[hash.get('m')] || byId['api-p99'])).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy per rubric. Initial screen self-describes within seconds: subtitle 'volatile metric monitor · cell-j04-s04' (screenshots/1280x860.png header; index.html:18), per-tile name/unit/value/delta/spark/state line ('crit · 54s', 'ok · 2m16s calm'), group headers with '8/8 ok', '3/8 ok · 4 warn · 1 crit' rollups, and a labeled trace legend (value/warn band/crit band/breach/recovered/spike, index.html:59-66).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen, zero page transitions; the primary object is reached in ≤1 interaction: click on tile (app.js:284), strip segment (app.js:306), or feed entry (app.js:330) selects and traces; keyboard Enter/Space on tiles (app.js:285); '/' focuses filter (app.js:616); All/Warn+/Crit chips (index.html:33-37) cut 29 tiles to anomalies; deep-link #m=&f= supported (app.js:634-636); 'Locate tile' scroll+glow reverses selection (app.js:563-567).

context_loss.evidence: Selection mutates only the right rail (selectMetric toggles classes and panel visibility, app.js:548-562) while the grid, strip state, scroll position and 1s tick continue uninterrupted; severity filter is a deliberate user action with comment acknowledging reflow is meaningful (style.css:93-96); Escape first clears the filter text before dropping selection (app.js:617); no modes or route changes exist in index.html.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly header, strip, grid, and two side panels (index.html:13-71); controls are one filter input, three severity buttons, and Pause (index.html:32-38) — nothing decorative. Each surface maps to a brief need: strip=tiny glance detection, grid=high density, feed+trace=high temporality/traceability; even the header clock pairs with the event-log timestamps (06:57:01 CRIT row in screenshots/1440x900.png).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all four a11y checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json checks). Source corroborates: faint #55657a text on dark panels (style.css:5) at 9.5-10.5px (style.css:110,150,188), 8.5-9px badges (style.css:144,167), 11px-tall clickable strip segments (style.css:55) and 22px-tall trace buttons (style.css:160); strip segments (app.js:304-307) and feed entries (app.js:330) are click-only divs without tabindex/role/keydown. Credit for intent: role=button+aria-label+tabIndex tiles (app.js:271-272), aria-pressed on chips/pause (index.html:34-38, app.js:591,609), :focus-visible outline (style.css:90).

frontend_rework.evidence: Receipt: 2 pass / 5 fail / 1 warning (measurement-summary.json summary), including layout.overflow: fail — implying rework — though I could not localize any overflow visually in either operator screenshot; layout.responsive_collision and text.truncation pass and both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) render with no visible collision, clipping, or truncated text; remaining failures are the four a11y/type checks (see accessibility), which imply rework effort but not visible layout defects.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声' is directly engineered and visible. Traceable: per-metric event log with timestamps, before→after values and rules (app.js:161-166,251,536-545), on-chart breach/recovered/spike markers (app.js:516-529; CHANGE TRACE event rows 06:56:53–06:57:01 with z=6.3–7.4 in screenshots/1440x900.png), incident duration/peak/escalation tracking (app.js:176-179,253-257); flatline detection and 'in band after 1m02s' recovery shown in source/shots/03-trace-flatline-recovery.png. No-flicker: 2-tick debounce state machine (app.js:35 DEBOUNCE=2, app.js:206-214), eased spark bounds (app.js:342-343), guarded DOM writes comparing previous text (app.js:381-389), spike coalescing SPIKE_COALESCE=8 (app.js:223-227), stable one-segment-per-metric slots (app.js:302-304).

defects_observed: layout.overflow: fail in receipt (measurement-summary.json checks) — overflowing element not visually identifiable in either operator screenshot
a11y.contrast: fail — faint #55657a token (style.css:5) used for 9.5-10.5px labels on dark panels (style.css:110,150,188), ~3.2:1 against #0a0e14
a11y.target_size: fail — 11px-tall clickable strip segments (style.css:55) and 22px-tall trace buttons (style.css:160)
a11y.focus_order: fail consistent with click-only interactive divs lacking tabindex/role/keyboard handlers (app.js:304-307, app.js:330)
type.min_projected_size: fail — 8.5px legend/badge type (style.css:167), 9px feed badges (style.css:144), 9.5px group tags and clock labels (style.css:110,150)
scores.overall_note: The package is a single-screen volatile-metric monitor whose four permanent surfaces (fleet strip, grouped 29-tile grid, evidence stream, change trace) map one-to-one onto the brief's volatile-evidence-stream shape bundle; the active crit incident dominates first paint in both operator screenshots and the trace panel opens on it by default (app.js:633-636), so the monitor job and the acceptance seed — traceable changes without flicker noise — are visibly and structurally addressed (debounced state machine, coalesced spikes, annotated chart + timestamped event log). The dominant weaknesses are measurable, not visual: the receipt fails 5 of 7 checks (measurement-summary.json), with all four accessibility/type checks failing and corroborated in source by sub-10px type, 11px/22px targets, low-contrast faint text, and click-only non-focusable strip/feed regions, plus one unlocalized layout.overflow failure — while responsive_collision and text.truncation pass and both viewports render cleanly. At 1280x860 the fourth group (Ingest Pipeline) sits below the fold but is reachable by in-grid scroll and mirrored in the strip, a density tradeoff rather than a defect. Time-to-understand is scored only as the rubric's model-judged proxy, and per the rubric these are model observations, not human-preference evidence.
